title: Kura instance has no ready replicas

model.expr: (max by (cluster, namespace, statefulset) (kube_statefulset_replicas{namespace="kura"}) > bool 0) * on (cluster, namespace, statefulset) (max by (cluster, namespace, statefulset) (kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready{namespace="kura"}) == bool 0)

annotations.summary: Kura instance {{ $labels.statefulset }} has no ready replicas in {{ $labels.cluster }}
annotations.description: An instance with desired replicas has no Ready backend for at least two minutes. Treat this as unavailable cache service, not reduced redundancy. Check the public /ready endpoint, pod and node conditions, Cilium and DNS. Correlate other instances on the same node. Do not delete local data volumes to treat a node network partition; preserve data and diagnose connectivity first.
